autumn_fade.notes: The gradient used to be at an angle. No changes needed right now. Just wanted to note this down.

sunrise.notes: Need to change the gradient to vertical and update the body stroke to...maybe a dark blue (?) so that it better matches with Sunset slime.

polka_mint.notes: Keeping variant 2, however this does not have polka dots or the gradient from variant 1

aurora_veil.notes: Keep the visuals of Variant 1 but use the base date from Variant 2. Variant 3 should become a new slime called "Dark Aurora"

nebula.notes: Keep Variant 2 has Nebula. Spin out a Variant 1 as a new slime called Plum (will need adjustments before it goes live in the store).

raindrop.notes: Needs some tweaks so that it actually looks like a raindrop.

ocean_drift.notes: Merge the visual of Variant 1 with the data of Variant 2
